title: Threaded Barrier Fate
tagline: Compare synchronization barrier strategies under contention and uneven arrivals.

curves.label: Central Mutex Barrier
curves.code: function centralBarrier(n){let count=0, m=new Mutex(), cv=new CondVar(); return ()=>{m.lock(); count++; if(count===n){count=0; cv.broadcast();} else {cv.wait(m);} m.unlock();};}
curves.name: Central Mutex Barrier

curves.label: Dissemination Barrier
curves.code:
function disseminationBarrier(n){let k=Math.ceil(Math.log2(n)); let flags=Array.from({length:n},()=>Array(k).fill(false)); return (tid)=>{for(let r=0;r<k;r++){let partner=(tid + Math.pow(2,r))%n; let my=r; let old=flags[partner][r]; flags[partner][r]=true; while(flags[partner][r]===old){} }
};}
curves.name: Dissemination Barrier

curves.label: Sense-Reversing Tree
curves.code:
function treeSenseBarrier(n){let k=Math.ceil(Math.log2(n)); let sense=true; let cnt=Array(2*n).fill(0); return (tid)=>{let leaf=tid+n; cnt[leaf]=1; for(let v=leaf; v>1; v>>=1){cnt[v]++; if(cnt[v]===2){cnt[v]=0; } } // propagate release
};}
curves.name: Sense-Reversing Tree

curves.label: Spin-Wait with Adaptive Backoff
curves.code: function adaptiveSpinBarrier(n){let arrived=0, sense=false; return ()=>{let localSense= !sense; arrived++; if(arrived===n){arrived=0; sense=localSense;} else {let spins=1; while(sense!==localSense){ for(let i=0;i<spins;i++){} spins=Math.min(1<<10,spins*2); } } };}
curves.name: Spin-Wait with Adaptive Backoff
